title: Decision
description: A branching choice that selects between named metric variants. Answering every applicable decision produces a binding. See ADR-0004 and src/decisions/README.md.

applies_when.description: The traversal is stateful: this decision is asked only when an earlier answer matches. Absent means always asked. Validator: the referenced decision is not this one, the applies_when graph over all decisions is acyclic (which yields the asking order), and the referenced options exist.

options.description: Validator: option ids are unique within the decision.

default.description: Prevailing market practice, not the most defensible option. Validator: one of this decision's option ids.

default_rationale.description: Required in spirit wherever the default is not the strongest option: says why the market is wrong. Not machine-checkable.

parameters.description: Parameters this decision reads. Validator: parameter ids are unique across the ontology.

gates.description: Every metric this decision affects, and how (variants, affects, note). Validator: symmetric with each metric's gated_by.

reads_entities.description: Entities this decision needs, mirroring a metric's reads_entities. `properties` is optional until someone pins down which ones the decision reads. Validator: each entity exists and carries each named property, and the list is symmetric with the entities' read_by_decisions.

emits.description: False when choosing this option removes the gated machinery from the bundle entirely (single-currency drops FX properties).

parameters.description: Ids of this decision's parameters that the option uses. Validator: each is declared in the decision's parameters block.

labels.description: Metric id to display label, for decisions that change names but never formulas. Validator: keys are existing metric ids.

gate.description: Validator: the metric exists (warning if enumerated but unwritten); each listed variant belongs to it.

affects.description: What the decision changes when it does not select variants.
